title: Spire Link - Local API for AI Agents & Tools
description:
[b]Spire Link[/b] is a local REST-style HTTP API for Slay the Spire 2. It lets AI agents, LLM clients, bots and your own tools read the game state as JSON (hand, enemy intents, map, shop, rewards and more) and send actions such as playing a card, choosing a path or claiming a reward. Use it for automation, run logging or AI research. It is not an MCP server itself, but you can build one on top of it.

本地 HTTP API：讓 AI 代理、機器人和自製工具讀取遊戲狀態並操作遊戲。

The mod makes no decisions for you. With nothing connected, you play the game as usual.

[b]Verified only on game v0.107.1, singleplayer only.[/b] On another game version it may not load or may misread some screens; if it starts, [i]GET /health[/i] reports [i]untested_game_version[/i].

[h2]Install[/h2]
[list]
[*]Subscribe and start the game. The first time the game finds a new mod it asks whether to load mods; allow it.
[*]Install it once only: do not also put a copy in the game's [i]mods[/i] folder. With the same mod in both places the game loads only one of them.
[*]Modded play uses a separate set of save files. Your unmodded saves and progress are not touched.
[*]To turn it off for a while, disable it in the Modding tab of the game's settings, or start the game with [i]-nomods[/i].
[*]To remove it, unsubscribe. Its settings and data stay in [i]%LOCALAPPDATA%\SpireLink[/i]; delete that folder too if you want them gone.
[/list]

[h2]Settings and local data[/h2]
On first launch the mod creates [i]%LOCALAPPDATA%\SpireLink\SpireLink.cfg[/i] with the port (default 15528) and a random API key. It lives outside the Workshop folder, so updates keep your key.

The mod writes only to that folder and sends nothing over the network. With no program connected it still keeps a small log there: that it started and stopped, whether its two game patches were installed, when one of them triggers (with the id of the current event), and when the game's main thread stalls for 10 seconds. It saves no game states and no screenshots unless a program is connected. Automatic screenshots are off by default ([i]auto_capture[/i] in the config).

[h2]Security[/h2]
[list]
[*]The API listens on 127.0.0.1 only; other machines cannot connect. Do not forward the port.
[*]Every endpoint except [i]/health[/i] needs the API key. Any program that can read your config can control the game, so only run clients you trust.
[*]If the key leaks, close the game and delete [i]SpireLink.cfg[/i]; a new key is generated on the next launch.
[/list]

[h2]For developers[/h2]
Source code, API documentation and release zips: [url=https://github.com/PingChunChung/spire-link]github.com/PingChunChung/spire-link[/url]
